description: Ordered DETERMINISTIC dosha-cancellation (parihara) model for the Ashtakoota pack. NOT a weighted matrix and NOT a weighted accumulation. Doshas are detected, eligible pariharas are gathered, and a strict precedence + stacking policy selects at most one effect per dosha. Every parihara ships disabled; enabling any is a domain-review + founder decision, never an engineering default.

policy.trace_requirement: Whenever an enabled parihara fires, its rule_id, the raw koota score, the effect, and the resulting status MUST be recorded in the report's decision trace. Silent cancellation is prohibited.
policy.precedence_principle: Lower priority integer applies first. Within a single dosha, at most ONE parihara takes effect (EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST_PRIORITY) unless a rule is explicitly SINGLE_APPLICATION on its own.
policy.numeric_before_interpretive: Score-cancelling (numeric) pariharas are evaluated before interpretive-relief pariharas. A numeric cancellation, once applied, pre-empts any interpretive-relief rule for the same dosha.
policy.mutual_exclusion_principle: Contradictory pariharas list each other in mutual_exclusions; if one fires the others are suppressed for that dosha.
policy.mangal_scope: Mangal / Manglik (Kuja) dosha is OUTSIDE the 36-point Ashtakoota sum (DEC-019). It is a SEPARATE flag and MUST NOT be folded into the Guna score or cancelled by any Ashtakoota parihara. Included below only as a disabled, non-numeric placeholder flag.

effect_vocabulary.cancel_dosha: Numeric: the dosha's 0 is restored to the koota's full score. changes_numeric_score = true.
effect_vocabulary.partial_relief_interpretive: Interpretive only: severity wording is softened; the numeric score is UNCHANGED. changes_interpretive_severity_only = true.
effect_vocabulary.no_numeric_change: No numeric effect; used for separate-flag placeholders (e.g. Mangal).

stacking_vocabulary.EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST_PRIORITY: Among all eligible pariharas for ONE dosha, only the single lowest-priority-integer rule applies; the rest are suppressed.
stacking_vocabulary.NON_STACKING: This rule never combines its effect additively with another; if another rule already resolved the dosha, this one is skipped.
stacking_vocabulary.SINGLE_APPLICATION: This rule may apply at most once per evaluation for the dosha it targets.

rules.source_conflict_note: Some schools treat friendly-lords as a FULL cancellation (numeric), others as interpretive relief only. Candidate effects differ; NOT resolved.

rules.note: Placeholder ONLY so Mangal dosha is never silently folded into the Guna score. It is a separate report flag with its own matching rules if DilChat ever evaluates it.

precedence_and_stacking_summary.multiple_applicable_cancellations: EXCLUSIVE_HIGHEST_PRIORITY — lowest priority integer wins; others suppressed.
precedence_and_stacking_summary.same_lord_vs_friendly_lord: same-lord (priority 10) applies before friendly-lord (priority 20); friendly-lord is suppressed by mutual_exclusion when same-lord fires.
precedence_and_stacking_summary.score_cancellation_vs_interpretive_relie: numeric (cancel_dosha) is evaluated before interpretive (partial_relief_interpretive) for the same dosha; a numeric cancellation pre-empts interpretive relief.
precedence_and_stacking_summary.regional_variants: carried per-rule in regional_applicability; disabled until the regional school is confirmed.
precedence_and_stacking_summary.incomplete_source_support: rules with weak/absent source support are review_status BLOCKED_DOMAIN_SOURCE and stay disabled.
